born.why: This code improves survival by using a "taste first" strategy for unknown sweet-smelling fruits to avoid poisoning, while securely carrying known safe fruits and starving when necessary, balancing risk with the need for energy.

The code prioritizes survival by distinguishing between "starvation mode" (eat anything) and "foraging mode" (use trait-based generalization from diary to estimate risk), weighting recent experiences more heavily to adapt to changing environmental toxicity while avoiding known poisons unless necessary.

The code prioritizes avoiding known poison, leverages sweet smells as a heuristic for safety to minimize random poisoning risk, and balances energy expenditure by only tasting unknown fruits when hunger is moderate, while ensuring immediate consumption if starving or already carrying.

This code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisonous fruits, eating immediately if starving or when a fruit is confirmed safe, and cautiously tasting novel fruits only when hunger permits the risk, while preventing mid-carry swaps to ensure food reaches the pantry.

The code prioritizes survival by using diary records to identify known poisons (avoiding them unless critical) and known safe fruits (carrying/eating them), while using smell as a probabilistic heuristic for unknowns, only tasting sweet-smelling ones or eating unknowns when starvation is imminent.

The code improves survival by inferring safety for unknown fruits based on shared traits (color/shape) with known safe ones, allowing Fagi to carry beneficial items without tasting every single one, while strictly avoiding any fruit resembling a known poison.

The code prioritizes safety by avoiding known poisonous fruits and only tastes unknown ones if they smell sweet, reducing the risk of poisoning; it eats unknowns only when starving to ensure survival, and carries safe fruits to build a pantry for future stability.

The code prioritizes survival by using a weighted, recency-biased learning system that aggressively avoids traits linked to harm (negative scoring) while cautiously seeking safe foods, ensuring Fagi tastes ambiguous fruits only when hungry enough to justify the risk but never eats known poison unless starving.
